about: Synthetic evaluation set for the AI Command Post workspace (src/eval.ts). Made-up questions only: no client data, no real names. expectTier is the tier the question should get: light only for short plain look-ups and chit-chat; anything that needs reasoning, money, law, code or a plan is full. Add a case whenever a real failure is found.
